activity.role: Field primatologist beginning chimpanzee behavioral research at Gombe
activity.notes: Exact representative research-start year 1960 at Gombe in then-British-administered Tanganyika (now Tanzania), not an assertion that her 65-year chimpanzee studies lasted only one year or were located in a modern 1960 Tanzanian sovereign state. Later founded the Jane Goodall Institute in 1977 and Roots & Shoots in 1991. Died 2025-10-01.
